scope.source_population: all 2162 images in evaluator category-major, manifest-stable order
scope.target_data_use: existing aggregate and per-dataset metrics only; no target score-map computation, calibration, thresholding, or selection

pixel_ranking.raw_map: native per-stage logits, mean across stages, class softmax, before evaluator Gaussian smoothing
pixel_ranking.final_map: native evaluator output after configured smoothing
pixel_ranking.quantile_sampling: deterministic global stride 257 for descriptive distributions; ROC/AP use all pixels
pixel_ranking.anomaly_size_strata: source-mask-only tertiles computed and persisted before model inference
pixel_ranking.connected_components: 8-connected components on resized binary source masks; fixed before scores

routing.grain: arm x image x stage x semantic branch

source_perturbation_suite.selection: first 4 normal and first 4 anomalous images per VisA category in frozen evaluator order
source_perturbation_suite.comparison: each transformed input versus its own clean frozen A_E15 inference

feature_geometry.patch_mask: nearest-neighbor resize of source mask to the native 37x37 patch grid
feature_geometry.large_arrays: external artifact root; compact aggregates only in Git

gradient_probe.selection: first two normal and first two anomalous images per first three VisA categories, partitioned into fixed batches of four
gradient_probe.execution: eval mode, historical FP16 autocast policy, no optimizer step, no scaler step

local_sensitivity.population: same fixed 96-image source perturbation subset, clean inputs only
local_sensitivity.finite_difference: centered where feasible; descriptive derivatives only, never model selection

causal_evidence_policy.confirmed: direct frozen-model measurement plus a predeclared counterfactual or perturbation changes the predicted mediator and endpoint in the expected direction
causal_evidence_policy.likely: multiple independent frozen-model measurements align, including at least one robustness or temporal comparison, but intervention is incomplete
causal_evidence_policy.possible: one or more associations are directionally consistent but alternative explanations remain material
causal_evidence_policy.not_supported: predeclared measurement has adequate coverage and contradicts or fails to show the hypothesized signature
causal_evidence_policy.unknown: required observable is unavailable or evidence is too weak/incomplete
causal_evidence_policy.ranking_rule: exactly one primary, one secondary, and one tertiary bottleneck; all others unranked
causal_evidence_policy.selection_rule: select exactly one minimal mechanism using source-only evidence, parameter/compute simplicity, and compatibility with the frozen diagnosis; do not implement or train it

routing_stability.HEALTHY: mean map Spearman >= 0.90, top-1% overlap >= 0.70, and mean routing L1 <= 0.10 across the fixed suite
routing_stability.SUSPICIOUS: any HEALTHY condition fails without meeting UNSTABLE
routing_stability.UNSTABLE: mean map Spearman < 0.75, top-1% overlap < 0.50, or mean routing L1 > 0.25

feature_geometry_stability.HEALTHY: all-stage mean feature cosine >= 0.98 and linear CKA >= 0.95
feature_geometry_stability.DEGRADED: either HEALTHY condition fails without meeting STRONGLY_DEGRADED
feature_geometry_stability.STRONGLY_DEGRADED: all-stage mean feature cosine < 0.90 or linear CKA < 0.85

gradient_conflict.systematic: cosine <= -0.20 in at least two of three fixed batches for an active, decision-relevant family
gradient_conflict.severe: cosine <= -0.50 in at least two of three fixed batches
gradient_conflict.occasional: negative cosine occurs but the systematic rule is not met

family_utilization.UNDERUTILIZED: both weighted gradient share < 1% and drift-energy share < 1%
family_utilization.OVERACTIVE: drift-energy share > 60% or update-to-weight ratio exceeds the family median by > 10x with degraded functional geometry
family_utilization.HEALTHY: neither UNDERUTILIZED nor OVERACTIVE and the family is connected to at least one task loss
family_utilization.UNKNOWN: required gradient or optimizer mapping is unavailable
